title: Strong sturdy scrubber
text: Strong sturdy scrubber. Finally a nice brush with a thick sturdy handle. The brush part has nice thick and hard bristles for scrubbing the toilet. Especially if you have males in the house lol. They each come in a holder that opens and closes around the brush. The only thing I dont like about the holder is the side doesnt close enough on the top and the bush has a tendency to fall out when it opens unless you lean it against something.
